title: ReceiverHeartbeat
description: Canonical request to POST /api/v1/receiver-lite/heartbeat, sent every 10 seconds. sequence is unsigned and strictly increasing within the session; a repeated or older heartbeat responds 409 CONFLICT and does not renew the lease.

sequence.description: Unsigned, strictly increasing heartbeat sequence within the session

sent_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the heartbeat was sent; informational, not used for the local lease timeout
